title: Udgam EUDR geolocation file
description: The GeoJSON file served at /api/verify/{batchId}/geojson?h= (technical-plan §12, TP24; docs/eudr-geojson.md). An RFC 7946 FeatureCollection in WGS84 with [longitude, latitude] positions, one Feature per plot of the batch, shaped to the European Commission's EUDR GeoJson File Description v1.5 (5 May 2025).

position.description: [longitude, latitude] in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), rounded to 6 decimals; no altitude.

ring.description: A closed linear ring: at least 4 positions, the last equal to the first, and counter-clockwise (RFC 7946 §3.1.6, as an exterior ring). Closure and orientation are checked by the builder's tests; JSON Schema cannot compare items.

multiPoint.description: A plot under 4 ha anchored as several parts: one interior point per part, in part order (EXE26).

polygon.description: Outer ring only: holes are rejected by the EU system.

multiPolygon.description: A plot anchored as several parts: each part has its outer ring only.

ProducerName.description: EU property. The pseudonymous producer ID, never a farmer's name (EV16).

ProductionPlace.description: EU property. The district and state, never a village.

Area.description: EU property, Points and MultiPoints only. Hectares, two decimals (the whole plot's area); a plot shown as 4.00 ha or more is a Polygon or MultiPolygon, so a Point's or MultiPoint's Area is at most 3.99.

commodity.description: Udgam property (ignored by the EU system).

hs_code.description: Udgam property. Coffee, not roasted, not decaffeinated (EUDR Annex I, heading 0901).

quantity_kg_cherry.description: Udgam property. The whole batch's fresh-cherry kilograms (not per plot, and not the net mass of a DDS).

crop.description: Udgam property. The batch's crop as the certificate shows it.

certificate_url.description: Udgam property. The absolute certificate URL with its h.
